description: Continuous banded-Gram profile using the interval-certified second-exchange 17-term seven-point local certificate.
status: analytic-extension research candidate; local numerical inputs interval-certified; new banded-Gram profile requires independent human review before root promotion

banded_gram.profile: g_q(E)=E for E<=T_q and g_q(E)=2*sqrt(T_q*E)-T_q for E>=T_q, with T_q=(q+1)/q. The proof rescales the q-band matrix to operator norm at most one before applying the Frobenius distance to the negative-semidefinite cone.

promotion_policy: Do not replace root candidate.json solely from numerical CI. The local certificate is rigorous, but the continuous banded-Gram analytic profile and its insertion into shifted-block pinching require independent mathematical review first.
